definitions.explanation: Physically elevated pressure or electrical voltage. Used in scientific, industrial, and weather contexts.
An overbearing, forceful, or intimidating manner of dealing with people. Describes someone who uses their authority or personality to dominate others.

examples.japanese: {高圧|こうあつ}⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧。
{高圧|こうあつ}⟦{電線|でんせん}→電線：11507_densen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近|ちか}づかないで→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not approach the high-voltage power lines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{去|さ}った→去る：02115_saru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{高圧|こうあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{張|は}り⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧きた。
examples.english: After the typhoon passed, a high-pressure system moved in.

examples.english: I wish you would stop being so overbearing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高圧的|こうあつてき}→高圧的：18279_kouatsuteki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧にくい。
examples.english: My boss is so domineering that it's hard to talk to him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高圧的|こうあつてき}→高圧的：18279_kouatsuteki⟧な⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧トーク⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{押|お}されて→押す：02854_osu⟧、⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was pressured by their aggressive sales pitch and ended up signing the contract.

notes:
Has both a physical/technical meaning (high pressure, high voltage) and a figurative meaning (overbearing, coercive). The figurative sense is most commonly expressed with the derived adjective ⟦{高圧的|こうあつてき}→高圧的：18279_kouatsuteki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高圧|こうあつ}⟦{電線|でんせん}→電線：11507_densen⟧: high-voltage power lines
- {高圧|こうあつ}⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧: high-pressure gas
- ⟦{高圧的|こうあつてき}→高圧的：18279_kouatsuteki⟧: overbearing, high-handed (na-adjective)
- ⟦{高圧的|こうあつてき}→高圧的：18279_kouatsuteki⟧な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: overbearing attitude
- ⟦{高気圧|こうきあつ}→高気圧：14808_koukiatsu⟧: high atmospheric pressure (weather term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高圧|こうあつ} (high pressure) ↔ {低圧|ていあつ} (low pressure)
- ⟦{高圧的|こうあつてき}→高圧的：18279_kouatsuteki⟧ (overbearing) ↔ ⟦{低姿勢|ていしせい}→低姿勢：10135_teishisei⟧ (humble, modest)

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧ (high) + {圧|あつ} (pressure).
